items.description: S0-VTOL with ship launch and autonomous landing capability
Atmospheric sounding sensor package (vertical profile to ~15,000 ft ceiling)

notes: Concept-stage NOAA research vessel (Ron Brown) deployment for autonomous atmospheric sounding missions. Requirements: ship launch/recovery, ~15K ft ceiling, 1+ km vertical profiling, 45-day endurance target, ~8hr data turnaround. Preliminary $18k identified; NOAA pursuing additional Ron Brown funding. Spring 2028 target mission. Publication collaboration expected.
